correctness.rationale: Independent construction of the 2n-state Markov generator and Fourier conjugate blocks gives lambda_{k,+}=p(cos(phi)-1)-u+sqrt(u^2-p^2 sin^2(phi) +/-2i delta u p sin(phi)). For 0<delta<1 the positive real part B_u(v) decreases with v^2; combining increasing spatial dissipation on positive-cosine arcs with explicit negative-cosine bounds for n=4..7 proves gamma=min{2u,p(1-cos theta)+u-B_u(p sin theta)} for n>=4, theta=2pi/n. The bijective t=z/a parametrization and derivative of (t-1)(1-delta^2 t^2)/(t+1) yield unique cubic t^3+t^2-t=delta^-2, optimizer and full-gap comparison. The delta^(2/3) expansion follows by singular balance. Independently built numerical full generators for n=4,5,7,10 and delta=.01,.2,.8 (12 cases) match the predicted global candidate and nearby comparisons. These finite matrices supplement, not replace, analytic proof. Spectral gap does not imply total-variation mixing optimality.
